scope: Theorem 7.1 (Surplus construction) of the manuscript “Single-exponential recovery and bounded-price strictness for metric k-median” (preprints/Single-Exponential-Recovery-and-Bounded-Price-Strictness-for-Metric-k-Median-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 125 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 823fdb284a7d3c0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the metric range above and fixed v, the construction underlying Theorem 1.2 of [9] can be run in polynomial time at any target 2 ≤ h ≤ |F|. With precision η = 2−N , its output has one of the following forms. (i) A solution of η-valid sequences with exactly h distinct regular facilities and at most L = Ov(log N) free copies, for some final price f > 0 and specified final copy lengths. (ii) A solution of 0-valid sequences containing only regular facilities, at price f = N−2, with at most h facilities. One common integer L can be used for all targets on an instance. For every regular opening, the algorithm also returns its witness set and certified bids.
